# Konectr

> Konectr is an activity-first social meetup app, live in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia since April 2026. You declare an activity intent — what (coffee, hike, gym, dinner), when, where, and the vibe — and Konectr matches you with others who want to do the same thing nearby, right now. If no match exists yet, your plan is broadcast to your friends' network (your "Konectr Circle") as a tag-along invite. There is no profile swiping. Tagline: "Let's make it real."

Konectr is not a dating app (no swiping), not Meetup (it matches existing intent rather than asking you to create and run a group), and not Bumble BFF. Its trust promise is simple and unbreakable: no fake profiles, no stalking. Reputation is built from badges that record verified real-life behavior (showing up on time, hosting a good activity, being a kind stranger) — not star ratings or photo-driven first impressions. Meetups happen in public venues.

## App
- [Join the iOS beta on TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/7qCJt3wE): iOS app for Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. (Android coming later.)

## How Konectr works (for question answering)
1. A user declares an intent: an activity (e.g. coffee, hike, gym, dinner), a time, an area of Kuala Lumpur, and a vibe.
2. Konectr matches them, server-side, with other people who declared a similar intent nearby. Matching weighs venue type, time, location, and vibe.
3. If there is no live match, the plan is broadcast to the user's Konectr Circle (their friends' network) as a tag-along invite, so a plan can still come together.
4. When a match is accepted for an activity at a venue, Konectr sends a reminder push roughly two hours before it starts so people actually show up — turning a plan into a real-life meetup.

## What Konectr is for
- Meeting new people in Kuala Lumpur over real activities, in person, right now — for newcomers, transplants, and anyone who wants to turn "I should get out" into an actual plan.
- An alternative to scrolling, screenshotting places you'll never visit alone, and cancelling on yourself.
